findings.summary: wiki_rename still performs its uniqueness gate outside the single write lock, so INV-2 ('标题任意时刻全库唯一') and INV-3 remain defeasible by concurrency. The find_page_by_title/TITLE_EXISTS check runs at lines 402-404, before _mutate acquires self._lock (store.py:105), and _write never re-checks. Two concurrent renames targeting the same new_title both observe 'absent', then serialize, and Path.rename silently overwrites the destination on POSIX — destroying an already-committed page and its server-issued id. This is exactly the defect class the previous final review blocked for wiki_create; only wiki_create was fixed by adding _check_title_exists_locked inside the locked _write, while wiki_rename (and wiki_delete's inlink gate) were left on the pre-lock path.

validate_edit_grade does not implement spec §4's edit-grade rule '结果页不得比操作前新增违规项'. It only compares presence for the fixed key list (创建日期, tags, 类型, source_type, credibility) plus id and summary length, so two classes of newly-added violation pass: (1) dropping 摘要 — a §2 create-time required field — via wiki_update(ref, body, frontmatter_without_摘要) is accepted although it newly introduces a missing required field; (2) mutating an enum to an illegal value (e.g. 类型: '垃圾', credibility: '超高', or tags changed to a non-list) is accepted because the key is present in both old and new frontmatter and no value re-validation is performed. wiki_update therefore lets a client turn a compliant page into a non-compliant one, which edit-grade exists to prevent. No test covers either path.

WikiSearch.rebuild indexes every scanned page unconditionally, including unparseable pages whose id is None (_load_index correctly filters these, rebuild does not). After katana-wiki-v2-mcp --rebuild-index on a repo containing a bad page, the keyword and vector indexes hold an entry keyed None, and wiki_search can surface it because find_page_by_id(None) matches that page. INV-6 requires the bad page to be isolated from global search rather than injected into it.

WikiSearch.remove_page swallows lancedb row-deletion failures with a bare 'except Exception: pass', discarding the original error text, contrary to spec §9's blanket prohibition on silent exception swallowing. This repeats the sole finding the Continuous reviewer raised for this attempt, which was left unaddressed.

wiki_ingest_plan now returns an applicable plan, but every candidate is emitted with action 'create' even when an exact-title page already exists (that fact is only reflected in the 'similar' list with reason 'exact title match'). A caller round-tripping the plan into wiki_ingest_apply will then hit TITLE_EXISTS. Spec §3 asks plan to give a per-candidate 'create-vs-已存在近似页' decision, which argues for a distinct non-create action in the exact-match case.
